Your Meta ads keep landing the wrong people. This is the buyer research that fixes it, from a live ICP report to ad scripts that sound human.
Want this built for your agency or business? Book a call: [BOOKING LINK]

Meta's Andromeda engine now pulls buyers in from every stage of the funnel, not just the top, so who you speak to decides everything. In this video I walk through the exact research we do before writing a single ad, landing page, email or video script.

What you'll learn:
• Why 6–8 ads in an ad set end up with only a couple getting spend, and why even the winners miss your ideal customer

• ICP Research Radar, the AI agent I built to research your top 3 ideal customer profiles
• A live report for a med spa client (88% fit): fears, desires, buyer questions and real quotes, each with an impact score
• How one audience splits by objection (40% / 25% / 15%) and why each slice needs its own message
• Diagnose before you write: tracing every creative decision back to a real buyer quote
• Turning a buyer's own fear into an opening hook in Claude, using Breakthrough Advertising and the five stages of awareness
• A script review on a no-show problem worth about £1,000 a month, the reminder sent 24 hours before, and a rebooking workflow in GoHighLevel
• How to spot the tells that make AI scripts sound off, and why I get scripts 90% done with AI, then speak every word myself

linkedin.text:
Your Meta ads are getting spend. They're still reaching the wrong people.

Put 6–8 ads in an ad set and only a couple end up getting spend. Even those winners can miss your ideal customer.

Meta's Andromeda engine now pulls buyers in from every stage of the funnel, so who you speak to decides everything.

So before we write a single ad, we research the buyer:
→ the top 3 ideal customer profiles, each with a fit score
→ their fears, desires and the questions they ask before booking
→ real quotes, each with an impact score

For a med spa client, the top profile scored an 88% fit. One fear stood out: someone googles a med spa, calls, gets no answer and books at the place next door instead.

That fear became the hook.

Diagnose before you write. Every creative decision should trace back to a real buyer quote.

The full walkthrough is in the video. Want this built for your business? Book a call: [BOOKING LINK]

#MetaAds #FacebookAds #ICPResearch #AdCopywriting

I built an AI agent that finds your buyers' exact words before we write a single ad.

It's called ICP Research Radar. It researches a business's top 3 ideal customer profiles and scores each one.

For a med spa client, the #1 profile came back at 88% fit, with fears, desires, buyer questions and real-life quotes, each with an impact score.

The part most people miss: one audience isn't one message. In the live report, the audience splits by objection (40%, 25% and 15%), and each slice needs its own angle.

We use that one report for everything downstream: ads, landing pages, emails and video scripts.

Research first. Then write in their words, not yours.

Full walkthrough, including the live report: [YOUTUBE LINK]

I get my ad scripts 90% done with AI. Then I speak every word myself.

AI scripts have tells. People can hear them, even when they can't say what's wrong.

So the fix starts before the script. We take a buyer's real fear from our ICP research and turn it into the opening hook in Claude, using Breakthrough Advertising and the five stages of awareness.

In the video I review a script about a no-show problem worth about £1,000 a month: the reminder sent 24 hours before, and a rebooking workflow in GoHighLevel.

Then I show the tells that make an AI script sound off, and how to fix them.

AI gets you to 90%. Your buyer's words and your own voice do the rest.
